title: 36 Hours in Geneva
abstract: Don’t underestimate under-the-radar Geneva. This scenic city offers quirky museums, outdoor markets, great shopping and a creative food scene.

title: 36 Hours in Sydney, Australia
abstract: Venture past Sydney’s Central Business District to where residents live and play, and you’ll discover that the city’s heart is nowhere near the center of town.

title: 36 Hours in Nairobi
abstract: From giraffe kisses to country music, spend some time with the delights of Kenya’s capital.

title: 36 Hours in Nairobi, Kenya
abstract: Intense traffic, a strong multicultural vibe, big global businesses — and yet you can still feed giraffes and elephants within the city limits.

title: 36 Hours in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico
abstract: With its inventive food scene, excellent beaches and “Night of the Iguana” mystique, the city makes the perfect weekend getaway.

title: 36 Hours in Amman, Jordan
abstract: Amman is often a pit stop on the way to Petra, but there are enough old and new flavors to keep visitors satisfied for a weekend.
